system_profile.system_purpose: order-dispatch is an async FastAPI + Pydantic v2 microservice that prices multi-line customer orders in integer cents, persists fulfillment records via a repository Protocol port, and dispatches non-blocking outbound partner webhooks with bounded timeouts.
system_profile.domain_context: E-commerce order intake, loyalty-tier pricing (Standard vs. VIP), order persistence, and asynchronous fulfillment webhook notification.
external_integrations: Partner fulfillment webhook HTTP endpoint configured via ORDER_DISPATCH_WEBHOOK_URL (default https://partner-gateway.internal/v1/events)

structure_map.architecture_pattern: Strict 4-Layer Acyclic Clean/Hexagonal Microservice (api -> services -> domain + infra)

layers.name: Composition & Config Root
layers.responsibility: FastAPI application factory, asynccontextmanager lifespan wiring, and centralized pydantic-settings configuration.

layers.name: API Layer
layers.responsibility: HTTP routing, dependency injection, and strict Pydantic v2 request/response DTO serialization.

layers.name: Application Service Layer
layers.responsibility: Stateless orchestration of order pricing, async webhook dispatch, and repository persistence.

layers.name: Domain Layer
layers.responsibility: Pure immutable order value objects, enums, and integer-cents pricing/VIP discount invariants with zero external dependencies.

layers.name: Infrastructure Layer
layers.responsibility: OrderRepository Protocol + in-memory adapter and timeout-bounded async httpx webhook notifier.

modules.role: FastAPI factory and async lifespan dependency composition
modules.health_note: Clean wiring; defaults to InMemoryOrderRepository in lifespan.
Typed response_model and Depends(); /v1/orders lacks auth dependency.

modules.role: Pure integer-cents subtotal and VIP discount calculator
modules.health_note: Zero framework or I/O imports; 95.2% line / 90.0% branch coverage.

modules.role: Async httpx webhook client with bounded timeout and graceful fallback
modules.health_note: Explicit timeout_sec=5.0; needs MockTransport branch tests (55.6% line cov).

structure_map.boundary_assessment: Exemplary downward-only acyclic layering with 0 circular dependencies and 0 boundary violations; domain package is completely free of FastAPI/httpx/Pydantic imports.

execution_flows.name: Order Creation & Async Webhook Dispatch
steps: FastAPI validates inbound JSON via CreateOrderRequest (extra='forbid', normalized uppercase SKU).
create_order() resolves OrderDispatcherService via Depends(get_dispatcher) and converts lines via to_domain_lines().
OrderDispatcherService.place_order() calls compute_order_total_cents() for integer-cent subtotal and VIP discount.
AsyncWebhookClient.notify_order_accepted() posts event with explicit timeout_sec=5.0, degrading to WEBHOOK_DEFERRED on httpx.HTTPError.
OrderRepository.save() persists finalized OrderRecord and to_order_response() returns HTTP 201 JSON.

execution_flows.name: Readiness Probe & Order Lookup
steps: GET /healthz returns ServiceSettings metadata as frozen HealthResponse (HTTP 200).
GET /v1/orders/{order_id} queries OrderDispatcherService.find_order() -> OrderRepository.get() and raises HTTP 404 when absent.

state_and_storage: Application-scoped dependencies stored on FastAPI app.state during asynccontextmanager lifespan (src/order_dispatch/main.py).
Default persistence adapter is process-local InMemoryOrderRepository behind OrderRepository Protocol (src/order_dispatch/infra/repository.py).
execution_flow_map.error_and_concurrency_model: Asyncio event loop via Uvicorn + FastAPI with non-blocking httpx.AsyncClient; domain invariant violations raise PricingError, missing lookups raise HTTPException(404), and outbound webhook httpx.HTTPError failures degrade gracefully to OrderStatus.WEBHOOK_DEFERRED with warning logs.
